name: incident-postmortem
description: Collect incident details via form, gate on human sign-off, then emit a structured postmortem Markdown document — or a rejection record if the postmortem is not approved.

fields.name: timeline
fields.description: Chronological timeline of events (detection to resolution)

steps.description: Incident commander or engineering lead must approve the postmortem before it is published.
steps.prompt: Review the collected incident details and approve the postmortem for publication, or reject if it needs revision.

steps.description: Emit the postmortem document (approved) or a rejection record (rejected).
steps.run:
jq -r '
  if .["sign-off"].decision == "approve" then
    "# Postmortem: " + (.["collect-incident"].title // "(untitled)") + "

" +
    "**Severity:** " + (.["collect-incident"].severity // "?") + "
" +
    "**Team:** " + (.inputs.team // "Platform") + "
" +
    "**Status:** Approved

" +
    "## Timeline

" + (.["collect-incident"].timeline // "(none)") + "

" +
    "## Impact

" + (.["collect-incident"].impact // "(none)") + "

" +
    if (.["collect-incident"].root_cause // "") != "" then
      "## Root Cause

" + .["collect-incident"].root_cause + "
"
    else
      "## Root Cause

_Under investigation._
"
    end
  else
    "# Postmortem REJECTED — not published

" +
    "**Incident:** " + (.["collect-incident"].title // "(untitled)") + "
" +
    "**Severity:** " + (.["collect-incident"].severity // "?") + "
" +
    "**Team:** " + (.inputs.team // "Platform") + "
" +
    "**Status:** Rejected — postmortem requires revision before publication.
"
  end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{postmortem: .}'
